questions.Description:
VERNIER CALIPER
i)   Measure the dimensions of ground MS flat/Cylindrical bush using Vernier
Caliper.
ii)   Compare the results with Digital Vernier Caliper.

OUTSIDE MICROMETER
i)   Measure the diameter of a wire using micrometer
ii)  Compare the results with a digital Outside micrometer

INSIDE MICROMETER
i)   Measure the inside diameter of the bore of a bush cylindrical component using Inside  micrometer
ii)   Compare the results with digital inside micrometer.

SLIP GAUGES
i)   Measure the thickness of ground MS plates using slip gauges.

VERNIER HEIGHT GAUGE
i)   Measure the height of gauge blocks or parallel bars using vernier height gauge.

MECHANICAL COMPARATOR
i)  Find out the measurement of a given component and Compare with a standard  component using a mechanical comparator and slip gauge.

UNIVERSAL BEVEL PROTRACTOR
i) Measure the angle of a V-block/Taper Shank of Drill/ Dovetail using universal bevel  protractor

SINE BAR
i)   Measure the angle of the machined surface using sine bar with slip gauges.

SCREW THREAD MICROMETER
i) Measure the geometrical dimensions of  V-Thread using screw thread micrometer.

GEAR TOOTH VERNIER CALIPER
i) Measure the geometrical dimensions of spur gear using gear tooth vernier caliper.
